audit.finding: The exact F-MR06 one-kernel lineage is retained; F-MR07 adds observation binding only.
No production I/O, parsing, file-unit or path dependency is added.
The hydraulic view contains physical state only and is separate from parameters, forcing, numerical configuration and results.
The process view is transient and adds no persistent per-column state.
No Newton vectors, Jacobian or solver workspace is exposed or stored.
The logical snapshot contract does not constrain future SoA, pooling or batching.
Only kernel_committed_state_t is accepted. Detached snapshots and returned views cannot mutate committed state.
A/B/A and detached-snapshot mutation tests prove deterministic cheap reconstruction from the same committed state.
The binding contains no day, midnight or calendar assumption.
Coupling-window semantics are unchanged.
Predictor-corrector and coupling transaction behavior are unchanged.
Groundwater head/flux interface contract is unchanged.
No flux or mass accounting is modified; exact F-MR06 authoritative-mass regression remains green.
Interface sensitivities are unchanged.
No coupling run-count or nonlinear solve policy is changed.
The view is constructed only on request and adds no heavyweight per-column solver object. Full large-scale access policy remains runtime work.
No 1-to-1 MODFLOW mapping assumption is introduced.
Deep-vadose composition is unaffected.
No cross-component storage transfer changes.
The qualified F-SI17 view consumes solver-neutral soil_water_physical_state_t, not one Richards implementation.
Existing F-MR06 physical and SNOW implementations are reused exactly; no physics is duplicated.
Process-facing access exposes only pressure head, water content, ponding depth and groundwater level, not HeadCalc internals.
No physical option or numerical execution policy is changed.
No bounded-cost or fallback behavior is added.
Reference behavior remains exact F-MR06; the full snow MultiSWAP reference fixture is replayed O0/O2.
The binding fails closed through explicit ok status; existing runtime diagnostics remain unchanged.
The view is nonpersistent and allocated only when requested; no irrigation-inactive column state is added.
The runtime only binds committed state to a process view and does not move tile/system composition into SWAP.
No midnight, one-day, file-format or MODFLOW dependency is introduced.
Exact source scope, F-SI17 provenance, transaction isolation, O0/O2 and full F-MR06 regression are explicitly qualified.

holds: F-MR07 does not implement or scientifically admit irrigation physics.
F-PM03 must still migrate and qualify irrigation-specific persistent state, timing, rollback/replay and exactly-once mass accounting before F-VQ scientific admission.
F-SI16 prescribed bottom-head work is independent and was not merged.
